events.body:
The driver cancelled this trip (F4), so NS-0 sends the case to NS-1/NS-2 — the no-show fee stands only if every NS-1 condition holds [F4][NS-0]. The record confirms the driver did arrive: he tapped "I'm Here" at 14:03:30 at 40 m from the pickup point and stayed within 200 m for 5 min 30 s thereafter, with a closest approach of 38 m [F7][F8][F1][NS-1]. The driver also made contact before cancelling, sending two in-app messages (first 14:04:00) and placing one in-app call (14:05:00) [F5][F11][F12][F14][NS-1].

The waiting condition fails, however. Under NS-2 any NS-1 condition that fails voids the charge, so the $5.00 cancellation fee on record must be refunded in full [F4][F9][NS-2]. No account flag attaches: the arrival tap was genuine — the driver was 40 m from the pickup point at the moment of the tap and never claimed otherwise — so the NS-2 flag condition (marking arrival while not at the pickup point) is not met [F1][F8][NS-2].
